WHY THE ADS?: 
For the record, I have no control over these horrible ADS due to YouTube’s updated policies, and I’ve never made a red cent from YouTube. If you know of a way to block YouTube’s new policy, let me know! 

YOUTUBE’S AD POLICIES: 
YouTube updated their AD policy in 2022 where they state: “Ads can now appear on videos from channels not in the YouTube Partner Program (YPP)…” However, to be in the YouTube Partner Program, you have to monetize your channel to control the ADS. Basically, YouTube now has the right to add the ADS they choose, if a channel does not own the content that is uploaded. I don’t’ own the S.C. content, so they can put ADS on this channel. I hate that, but I also know this platform reaches countless people, so don’t throw out the baby with the bathwater. 

https://blog.youtube/news-and-events/updates-to-youtubes-terms-of-service/ 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4T7_qGCX7WM 

WAYS AROUND THE ADS: 
Get YouTube Premium. It’s $15.99/month (individuals), $8.99/month (students) and $26.99/month (families). With YouTube Premium you won’t see any more ads while studying. https://www.youtube.com/premium I watch and study on my own private account when I'm on the road, which is a great deal of time, and I watch Ad Free and a monthly cost. I also watch from my ROKU at home, and it is Ad free because of YouTube Premium. Now, no one really wants to support the thieving YouTube, but it allows us to see the lectures and it’s reaching a lot of God’s Elect, putting His seal in their foreheads, the grey matter. 

GOOGLE CHROME AD BLOCKER: 
If one watches from their computer, and they use Chrome web browser, there are Ad Blockers for YouTube: https://chromewebstore.google.com/search/youtube%20adbock?hl=en-US&utm_source=ext_sidebar  

WATCHING ON YOUR CELLPHONE AD BLOCKER: 
If you watch on your cellphone, I use iPhone, when I go to the App Store, I typed "YouTube Ad Blocker" and several Ads come up that supposedly block the Ads. I haven't tried any, so can't vouch for what works and doesn't, because I have the YouTube Premium which blocks the Ads. If there are some that still are not convinced and think I'm a liar and a money maker? Well, don't trust this man or any other, without checking him out first. Here's how you do that:
